_: V90Modem::progress -- the side switch and nothing else.  What can go
wrong is the arm chosen and the arguments forwarded, so these move
one or the other.  t_v90modprog drives sides 0, 1 and two illegal
values, and the analog arm runs a real V90Demodulator.

label: the two arms are swapped
the digital arm forwards no symbols
the digital arm forwards the sample buffer as the bit vector
the analog arm forwards no symbols
an illegal side falls through to the modulator
the illegal-side report is not gated
